regime: Risk-on trend day, the second in a row. NQ and ES broke out together again and closed above their prior-day highs and above rising AVWAPs, with no major catalyst behind it. Gold reclaimed its ATR stop and flipped long, crude kept bleeding. The one caution is a VIX that ticked up while stocks rose, a stretched tape rather than a fresh breakout.
summary: Risk-on, day two. NQ tacked on another 3.08% to close near 29,819, roughly 231 points over its 29,588 stop and knocking on 30,000, while ES added 1.88% to a fresh 7,786 high. There was no big catalyst behind it: Tuesday's data was second-tier, trade balance, factory orders and JOLTS, and the tape just kept trending, every equity opening range breaking up for a second straight session. Gold flipped. It reclaimed its ATR stop and now reads long at 4,077, though it faded off a 4,101 high into the close. Crude kept bleeding, down another 6.17% to 75.13 after an overnight fake to 82.35, roughly a 13% two-day repricing. One quiet tell: the VIX ticked up to 16.50 even as stocks ripped, so this is a stretched tape, not a fresh breakout.
psychology: Two green trend days in a row breed overconfidence. NQ is up about 5.4% in two sessions and pressing a round number, which is exactly when chasing feels safest and has the worst location. The skill today is not calling the top, it is respecting where you stand: an entry near the 29,757 AVWAP has defined risk, an entry at the highs does not. And notice the VIX ticked up while price rose. That divergence does not call a reversal, but it is a reminder to size for a tape that can snap back, not one that owes you a third leg.

event.consensus: No top-tier scheduled release on Tuesday Aug 4; only second-tier prints.
event.actual: June trade balance, June factory orders and JOLTS job openings. None of it moved the tape.
event.surprise: No surprise large enough to matter. Equities simply extended the prior day's risk-on trend while crude kept repricing lower, so today reads as momentum drift, not an event day.
event.nqReaction: NQ trended up a second day to close +3.08% near 29,819; ES +1.88% to a new 7,786 high. Gold reclaimed its ATR stop and flipped long; crude fell another 6.17%.

risk.sizing: Volatility ticked up rather than down: MNQ ATR(14) 121.86 (from 119.49) and VIX 16.50 (+1.04%), so risk per contract is marginally higher than yesterday. After a two-day parabolic run, chasing the close near 30,000 has poor location. With-trend entries are better taken on pullbacks toward the 29,757 AVWAP, with the 29,588 stop defining risk.
risk.openRisk: NQ and ES are both long with real room over their stops (NQ +231, ES +43). Gold just flipped long above 4,065 but closed on its RTH low, so it is the softest long. Crude is short below 77.74. Keep equities, gold and crude as separate books; do not net them into one.
risk.note: Week ahead: ADP employment and ISM Services on Wed Aug 5, jobless claims Thursday, and the July jobs report Friday Aug 7. Prop-firm blackouts apply around ADP, ISM Services and Friday's NFP. Watch whether NQ can hold 30,000 or whether the VIX uptick and the fade off the highs mark the start of a pause.
